patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero layout with a large, bold text block on the left and a dynamic, collage-style arrangement of project images on the right.
Headings use a wide, modern sans-serif font with generous letter-spacing, contrasting with a more standard, lighter-weight sans-serif for body and descriptive text.
A predominantly minimal white background serves as a canvas, allowing vibrant, pastel-toned project imagery and footer graphics to stand out as primary accent colors.
The hero section's visual elements (project previews) exhibit a subtle parallax effect, scrolling at a slightly slower rate than the main heading text, creating a sense of depth.
Project listings are presented in a clean, borderless grid, each item featuring a prominent image and concise text, maintaining a consistent visual hierarchy.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a layered scrolling technique where background image elements are animated to move at a slower speed than the foreground text content, creating a subtle parallax effect as the user scrolls down. This effect is likely achieved using CSS transforms or JavaScript-based scroll-triggered animations.
The main navigation bar is implemented as a sticky element, remaining fixed at the top of the viewport to ensure constant access to site navigation.
Project entries are structured within a responsive grid layout, with each item containing an image and descriptive text, designed to adapt across different screen sizes.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, wide-set sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with standard-sized, lighter-weight sans-serif body text and small, uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Mostly sharp corners, with subtle rounding on interactive elements like buttons and some card-like project previews.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density overall, featuring an airy hero section with ample whitespace and a more compact, but still well-spaced, project grid.

standout: This site distinguishes itself with a playful yet sophisticated use of color and motion. The minimal white canvas allows the vibrant, pastel-toned project imagery to truly pop, while the subtle parallax in the hero section adds a dynamic, engaging layer without being distracting. The overall impression is one of modern creativity and meticulous attention to detail.
